This image can be found on Deviantart shot on the 30th November, 1999 by N-ixo titled Punk Boy. The image depicts a young punk boy with his mouth open chanting. The punk movement came to popularity in the mid to late 70s in the UK and United states and was characterised by a rejection of mainstream culture and prior counter cultural movements. I was into punk and ska more for the mosh pits than the music. Once a friend took waxing strips into the pit and put them on a boy’s eyebrows leaving him to rip them off. This had been done because the boy had been acting effeminately, what was termed amongst my friends as “gay”. In retrospect it feels like an act born out of my friend's fear of his own identity. Around this time I was attracted to an older boy who was in a band. If i thought about my attraction too much I would be struck by sickening anxiety that I might be gay and therefore rejected by my friends and family. Since then my experimentation with men have elicited little desire, I am unsure why and wonder if I have somehow conditioned myself to reject the possibility.
